undo_not_applied.message: Nothing to undo (only up to 24 hours back).

watered.name: Watered
watered.description: Refills the water level of the selected plants to 100 %.

snooze.name: Still moist
snooze.description: Selected plants are due again in 2 days; plants with more water stay unchanged.

bone_dry.name: Bone dry
bone_dry.description: Watered, the soil was bone dry (interval too long).

undo.name: Undo
undo.description: Undoes the last action of the selected plants (up to 24 hours).

fertilized.name: Fertilized
fertilized.description: Marks the selected plants as fertilized (only plants with fertilizing on).
